lastResponse.text: First call eight three three … seven four six … eight one six seven. That’s eight three three, seven four six, eight one six seven, Oregon Eviction Prevention Rapid Response for past-due rent. When they answer, say you’re in Hillsboro and one month behind. They can screen you now. Based on what I have, this program requires an active eviction Court case number and Court date.
originalTexts: First call **eight three three … seven four six … eight one six seven**. That’s **(833) 746-8167**, Oregon Eviction Prevention Rapid Response for past-due rent. When they answer, say you’re in Hillsboro and one month behind. They can screen you now. Based on what I have, this program requires an active eviction court case number and court date.
